messages:
maria: Heads up — from ~22:10 UTC we're seeing a surge in preempt evictions in us-west2. Tiny pods (<=0.2 GPU) getting evicted in waves, scheduler queue backlog up ~4x. GPU warm pools at ~95% utilization. Not sure yet if thermal or packing churn.
jon: saw the alert. can you paste the scheduler QPS/latency? any recent rollout?
ops-bot: Alert: evictions_count(us-west2)=312 since 2024-11-07T22:08Z. avg_schedule_latency=450ms. recent deploy: scheduler v2.4.1 @ 21:55Z.
ali: that's the rollout I flagged earlier — latebind affinity changes might be leaving sticky pins. adding a quick label-sync check now.
leo: can we rule out nvlink/thermal? node-exporter shows one rack with repeated GPU thermal throttles between 22:05-22:09.
maria: sample logs: ```kubelet: FailedAttachVolume: timeout binding vol-abc123
scheduler: schedule.go: bind attempt failed: node has taint gpu-preempt:NoSchedule
kubelet: attach/detach race```
jon: taint + latebind mismatch could be causing tiny pods to not pack and then end up on preemptible nodes. if warm pools are full, they fallback and get evicted quickly.
ali: immediate mitigation: bump tiny-pod binpack threshold to 0.5 GPU and pause the scheduler v2.4.1 canary. also consider temporarily increasing warm pool capacity by +2 nodes.
leo: cost tradeoff noted — increasing reserved tiny capacity adds ~3% hourly cost for west2, but saves restart/evict churn.
maria: I'm going to scale tiny warm pools by +2 nodes and initiate rollback of the canary now. monitoring dashboards open.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-20241107-23. Paging oncall @sre :rotating_light:.
jon: thanks — if rollback stabilizes, I'll take postmortem and collect scheduler traces + packer heuristic evals.
ali: I'll own followup to add a regression test preventing latebind from producing sticky affinity labels.
leo: I'll draft a short runbook snippet and telemetry queries to detect this pattern earlier; will drop in #eng-platform/ops-runbooks.
maria: update 22:28Z — evictions down to baseline after rollback and +2 nodes. holding changes until 23:00Z before reopening release train.
jon: great, thanks everyone :thumbsup:
